results.title: Global UX Designer Senior Manager
results.description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


Role Overview:


As a member of BCG’s Global IT Design Center of Expertise (CoE), you will be working to help define and design the delivery of service experiences for employees. You’ll be responsible for the creation and evaluation of service design blueprints, research, quant behavioural measurement and the analysis of employee needs. We are seeking an analytical and experienced Service Designer to join our dynamic cross\-functional team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for designing value\-creating, measurable and value creating service experiences.

  

Key Responsibilities:

* Service Design:
	+ Develop service design blueprints and guidelines to ensure consistency across services and to achieve BCG’s strategic goals.
	+ Utilize journey mapping, needs and sentiment analysis, quant measurement and other tools, methods, or processes to understand and define end\-to\-end service experience.
	+ Align with the CoE Value Measurement framework to capture and track service quality, efficiency and advocacy.
* Research \& Analysis:
	+ Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research to understand employee needs, behaviors, and pain points.
	+ Analyze behavioural analytics data to inform design decisions.
	+ Create meaningful and actionable insights into our employees’ behaviors, needs, expectations, and pain points.
* Collaboration:
	+ Work collaboratively across teams, disciplines, and regions to ensure a diverse approach to problem\-solving.
	+ Engage with senior leadership, showcasing service design work and evidencing the value your research and design work has accrued initiatives.
* Testing \& Iteration:
	+ Gather feedback to refine and improve service designs.
	+ Iterate on designs based on analytics and feedback to enhance the services experience.
* Innovation \& Trends:
	+ Stay uptodate with the design methods, tools, processes and technologies.
	+ Advocate for and implement best practices in service design.

  

What You'll Bring


Experience:

* Minimum of 7 years of commercial experience in service design, preferably in a large, global enterprise.
* Proven experience in research and analysis to create actionable insights.
* Practical knowledge of iterative design approaches
* Comfortable leading service design workstreams in large global teams across multiple time zones, collaborating with a diverse set of stakeholders.


Skills:

* Expertise in service design, design strategy, journey mapping, needs and sentiment analysis and quant behavioural analytics measurement
* Strong understanding of user\-centered design principles and methodologies.
* Very strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.


Personal Attributes:

* Innovative thinker with a passion for solving complex problems.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in a global, hybrid working environment.
* Outcome and measurement driven and focused on solving user and business problems.
* Pragmatic and adaptive thinker who can adjust design processes and approaches to project demands and deadlines.
* Ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity.
* Hands\-on practitioner able to think conceptually and work practically.
* Compelling storyteller and communicator.


Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Product Design, Service Design, or equivalent experience. Master’s degree preferred.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

results.title: UI Engineer - Mocks and Wireframes Specialist
results.description:
**About Centric Software:**

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI\-enabled product\-concept\-to\-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best\-of\-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever\-changing market.  



Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.  



**Job Specification: UI Engineer \- Mocks and Wireframes Specialist**

**Location:** Remote


**Position Type:** Permanent  



  

**Job Overview:**  

We are seeking a highly skilled UI Engineer with expertise in creating mockups, wireframes, and interfaces for data\-driven applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating design concepts into visually appealing and functional user interfaces. This role requires a strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles, proficiency in designing mockups and wireframes, and the ability to interface with APIs for seamless data integration.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Mockup and Wireframe Design:**

* Develop high\-fidelity mockups and interactive wireframes that align with the project requirements and design guidelines.
* Collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand user needs and business objectives.

**Interface Design:**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust, user\-friendly features and products using TypeScript, React and TailwindCSS.
* Create intuitive, scalable, and high\-performance user experiences through interactive UI components and effective application state management.
* Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across various devices and screen sizes.

**Data Integration:**

* Interface with APIs to integrate data seamlessly into the user interface.
* Collaborate with backend developers to understand data structures and optimize data presentation within the UI.

**Prototyping:**

* Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate the flow and functionality of the proposed user interfaces.
* Gather feedback from stakeholders and iterate on designs to achieve optimal results.

**Usability Testing:**

* Conduct usability testing on prototypes and finalized interfaces, incorporating user feedback into design improvements.
* Stay informed about industry best practices and emerging trends in UI/UX design.

**Documentation:**

* Document design decisions, guidelines, and specifications to ensure consistency and clarity for development teams.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to maintain design documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, React, TailwindCSS and extensive experience building complex web applications with React.js.
* Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD.
* Experience working with APIs and integrating data into user interfaces.
* Knowledge of user\-centered design principles and usability testing methodologies.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively across teams.

If you are passionate about creating visually stunning and user\-centric interfaces while excelling in collaborative environments, we invite you to apply for this exciting UI Engineer position. Join our team and contribute to building cutting\-edge data\-driven applications that redefine user experiences.  



*Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.*

results.title: Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Website Team
results.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Prime Video to deliver the vision of being the one\-stop destination for entertainment, and solve challenging and rewarding problems for the customers across the world. You will join one of the core client teams in Prime Video, and directly deliver new and exciting experiences for the millions of our customers.  

  

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, Movies, Live TV, Sports and more types of content \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. You will join the website team in Prime Video. We are available through the Amazon Retail Website, a dedicated global website, the Windows App as well as emerging devices via our newly launched Progressive Web Client. We uniquely obsess over giving customers the best first experience on Prime Video, as many customers discover Prime Video for the first time on our website. We also obsess over the availability, accessibility, scalability and reliability of our systems. As part of the website team in Prime Video, you will have the chance to directly and meaningfully impact the business and customers every day.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will work as part of one of our 2\-pizza teams, launching and growing new initiatives for Amazon's global business. You will be a significant independent contributor, owning highly impactful business outcomes. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Program Managers, UX Designers, Engineering partners, and Leadership across the company to deliver those outcomes. You will regularly challenge the status quo, and implement high standards of operations on your team. You will mentor and grow the next generation of engineers, as well as pursue opportunities to grow your own skills and career.  

  

A day in the life  

You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of customer or platform features \- working on front\-end (TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, Sass), back\-end APIs or webservers (Java, Scala), testing (Storybook, Playwright), and infrastructure (AWS, CDK). You will review code, design documents, and plan your work using standardised tools, and processes with your team. You will work with product, program, and UX owners to define, refine and iterate on prototypes.
  

  

About the team  

Our team owns the customer experience of some of the major entry points on Prime Video for video discovery, we drive complex business problems, build global technology solutions to provide customized compelling content to customers in each country where we operate. The team enables Prime Video customers to instantly discover, search, navigate, browse content, and manage preferences, primarily across website platforms using any modern web browser on any device anywhere in the world.  

  

The website team is a highly diverse and inclusive group, with passion for building real world solutions, experimentation and innovation at the core of our initiatives. We aim for keeping a self\-sustainable process of improvement in our tech stack, moving fast for creating new functionalities and delivering for strategic projects across Prime Video. We foster a culture of innovation and continuous growth, building a strong team and setting time for enjoying our work and having fun outside it.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large\-scale systems
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building web applications with React and modern web technologies
* Experience in AWS services

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
